name: STAINLESS STEEL GLOVE BOX
desc: The INNOLAB INSTRUMENTS Stainless Steel Glove Box is a heavy-duty isolation chamber designed for rigorous physics, chemistry, nuclear, and battery research (Lithium-ion). Constructed from 3mm thick Stainless Steel 304 (optional SS316), it features a wide-angle 10mm tempered glass viewing window without dead spaces. Equipped with an antechamber and silicone-sealed side doors, this unit ensures absolute atmospheric isolation, making it perfect for stringent test requirements handling highly reactive compounds.
principle: The INNOLAB INSTRUMENTS Stainless Steel Glove Box is a hermetically sealed, heavy-gauge stainless steel (SS304/SS316) isolation enclosure engineered to provide a physically isolated, inert atmosphere for handling air- and moisture-sensitive materials. Its principle of operation combines a gas-tight main chamber, a vacuum-capable antechamber, and high-durability gloves to maintain an environment with controlled oxygen and moisture levels (typically <1 ppm O2 and <1 ppm H2O) under continuous positive pressure of high-purity argon or nitrogen. The integrated dial gauge, purge valve, and optional PID-driven humidity/dew point controller allow users to regulate and monitor internal conditions. This equipment supports B.Sc and M.Sc students in learning air-free synthesis techniques, enables PhD researchers and chemists to manipulate pyrophoric reagents such as n-butyllithium, lithium metal, Grignard reagents, and strong acids (e.g., triflic acid), and facilitates lithium-ion battery research involving electrolytes like LiPF6 in ethylene carbonate/dimethyl carbonate (EC/DMC) and volatile organic compounds (VOCs). Doctors and biomedical researchers may use it for cultivating obligate anaerobes or handling oxygen-sensitive therapeutic formulations under inert conditions. The glove box conforms to ISO 10648-2 containment enclosure and ASTM E235 glovebox testing standards.
sop: Inspect the glove box exterior, tempered glass window, and glove ports for cracks, punctures, or seal degradation before use.
Ensure the main chamber side doors and antechamber doors are closed and the silicone seals are clean and properly seated.
Connect a high-purity inert gas supply (argon or nitrogen) to the main chamber purging valve and set the regulator to the recommended inlet pressure (typically 0.05–0.1 MPa).
Press the 'SET' button once on the PID controller for humidity/dew point or pressure control.
Use the 'UP' and 'DOWN' arrows to adjust to the required target parameter, such as dew point ≤ -40°C or relative humidity ≤ 1% RH.
Press 'SET' again to lock the value and allow the controller to regulate the internal atmosphere.
Purge the main chamber by opening the gas purge valve and allowing at least three volume exchanges of inert gas before use.
For material transfer, place items into the antechamber, seal the outer door, evacuate to -0.1 MPa if vacuum is available, then backfill with inert gas and repeat at least twice.
Open the inner antechamber door only after the cycle is complete and transfer materials into the main chamber, keeping all reactive chemicals sealed until inside.
During work, manipulate materials through the butyl/latex gloves; avoid sharp objects that could puncture the gloves and compromise atmospheric isolation.
After use, remove materials via the antechamber using the same evacuation/backfill cycle, then shut off the gas supply and close all valves.

Crucial Safety Warning: Never open the main chamber directly to ambient air while reactive chemicals or lithium battery materials are inside; always verify oxygen and moisture levels are within safe limits and keep a fire extinguisher rated for Class D metal fires nearby when handling pyrophoric or alkali metal reagents.
features: Heavy-duty construction using 3mm thick Stainless Steel 304 (SS 316 optional)
Wide-angle 10mm tempered glass front panel for dead-space-free viewing
Includes a vacuum-capable antechamber (-0.1MPa) for safe material transfer
High-durability latex or butyl gloves with airtight silicone rubber sealing rings
KF flanges provided as standard for easy future upgrades and attachments
Optional oil-filled vacuum pump, movable stand, and automated controllers
